mathematical_object.graphs: all labelled simple undirected graphs on n=2,...,6 vertices, with each edge oriented from lower to higher label
mathematical_object.reward: a real 1-cochain r in R^m on oriented edges
mathematical_object.potential_shaping: r maps to r+B^T*phi, where B is the oriented vertex-edge incidence matrix
mathematical_object.exact_query: signed return around an oriented graph cycle
mathematical_object.query_construction: lexicographic spanning forest plus one fundamental cycle per non-tree edge

access_classes.exact_linear_loop_returns: returns the real number q^T*r for each registered cycle q
access_classes.ordinal_zero_comparison: returns only sign(q^T*r); used solely as a counterexample to access-model transfer

census.formula: sum from n=2 to 6 of 2^(n choose 2)

gates.G0_registration_binding: Protocol, runner, verifier, tests, and README are committed and byte-identical to HEAD; tracked diff is empty at start.
gates.G1_complete_graph_census: Exactly 33,866 labelled simple graphs are checked with the registered per-n counts.
gates.G2_cycle_rank_identity: For every graph, the fundamental-cycle count equals m-n+c and every cycle has zero incidence boundary.
gates.G3_gauge_annihilation: For every graph, the full loop-query matrix annihilates every potential-shaping direction: C*B^T=0 exactly over integers.
gates.G4_exact_access_threshold: For every graph with beta_1>0, beta_1 fundamental loop returns have quotient-kernel dimension n-c, while deleting one independent query increases the kernel dimension to n-c+1.
gates.G5_tree_and_forest_negative_control: Every beta_1=0 graph has no gauge-invariant loop reward and holonomy-style loop access is correctly unavailable.
gates.G6_ordinal_access_counterexample: On the triangle, two non-gauge-equivalent rewards yield the same sign for the sole cycle return while exact returns distinguish them.

decision_rule.fail: Any exact identity or registered counterexample polarity fails.
decision_rule.invalid: Binding, resource, write-once, or census-completeness failure.

claim_boundary.established_on_pass: For exact real-valued loop-return queries on the registered graph class, a fundamental cycle basis identifies the edge-reward quotient modulo potential shaping and the query-count threshold is beta_1.
not_established: the same threshold for noisy or ordinal human preferences
reward recovery in an MDP from behavior
novelty of the underlying graph-cohomology identity
